Crop of one slip from a Players Committee Virtual card sheet, showing the label above the slip and the margin note beside the slip number, for [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Light) (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier) (Original)|Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Light) (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)]]: the label and face print "Lars'"; the margin note prints "•Tatooine: Lars Moisture Farm (Light) (V)" without the apostrophe.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards15.pdf#page=6 VirtualCards15.pdf], Virtual Set 15 Remaster sheet, page 6, slip 30. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193554/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards15.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]

Edits: the slip area was rendered from the PDF at 216 dpi and cropped; nothing else changed. Used on [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History#Slip labels and margin notes]].
